Place.description: An administrative place in the WOF geo_places gazetteer (D-GeoPlaces). `id` is the RID; used e.g. as a vehicle plate region (placetype=region).

countryId.description: The RID of the containing country.

id.description: The place's RID (location service); what consumers (e.g. vehicle registrations) reference.

name.description: Default-locale display name; other locales arrive via the i18n store.

PlaceList.description: The places matching the query, in name order.

Platform.description: An instance-admin catalog entry naming a social network / messenger (D-PersonSocialChannels). Stable code + translatable name + category.

category.description: One of messenger | social. Only messenger platforms may carry a messenger link.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier (D-Code); immutable by convention.

name.description: The translatable label as a locale -> text map (all enabled locales; D-i18n).

Policy.description: An institutional rule/regulation (optionally approved by a governance body).

PoliticalLeaning.description:
An INFERRED political leaning (D-PersonOverlays, M35) — an Object. Political opinion is a GDPR
Art. 9 special category, so `spectrum` is envelope-encrypted at rest; the value here is decrypted
(0 for a crypto-erased tombstone). legalBasis is required. This is a SEPARATE overlay and is NEVER
merged with the declared M33 party membership. pii:special.

inferenceSources.description: The inference methodology tags, e.g. social_media | voting_record | donation_records.

legalBasis.description: The platform_legal_basis_kinds code authorizing this Art. 9 inference.

spectrum.description: The inferred left/right position in [-1,1]. Decrypted; 0 when crypto-erased.

Position.description:
A unit-owned billet (D-Position) — an Object that exists whether or not anyone fills it (a
VACANCY is an active position with no active filling). Position grants no authority. The
current holder is populated by getPosition and by listPositions (null when vacant).

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier, unique within the unit; immutable by convention.

holder.description: The current active filling, if any. Populated by getPosition and listPositions; null when vacant.

id.description: The position's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

requiredRankId.description: Optional advisory establishment rank (a rank RID); never enforced against any filler.

sortOrder.description: App-managed display order within the unit.

status.description: One of active | abolished (abolish is a reversible status flip).

title.description: The billet title as a locale -> text map (default-locale fallback + i18n translations).

unitId.description: The URN RID of the owning unit.

PositionPage.description: A page of positions plus the opaque token for the next page (empty when exhausted).

PrincipalGrant.description:
One permission code held by a MACHINE subject (M51 / D-ServiceIdentities) — the reified
PRINCIPAL_GRANT link. FLAT by construction: no target unit, no scope, no graph, because a
service principal has no unit reach.

`orgId` absent means INSTANCE-WIDE (reference-catalog imports, the M53 wiring codes); a named
organization confines the principal to that organization's data — the blast-radius boundary
for a connector is the organization, not the unit.

orgId.description: Absent = instance-wide; present = confined to that organization.

permission.description: A code from the closed permission catalog.

principalId.description: The service principal's URN RID (registered on IdentityFederationService).

Program.description: A degree/diploma/certificate program of an institution (optionally a unit).

Publication.description: An academic publication (optionally tied to an institution).

Qualification.description: A formally awardable qualification (degree) classification of an institution.

QualificationAward.description: A person was awarded a qualification (the diploma award).

Rank.description: A specific grade within a type (e.g. sergeant, associate_professor), ordered for exact seniority.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier (D-Code); unique within its type among active ranks.

gradeCode.description:
Optional standardized cross-system grade (NATO STANAG 2116; one of the GET /rank-grades
codes). Two ranks are equivalent across systems when they share a gradeCode; absent => no
cross-system comparison.

id.description: The rank's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

name.description: locale->text display name (all enabled locales; default-locale fallback + i18n store).

sortOrder.description: Seniority ordinal among active siblings within the type (lower = more junior).

systemId.description: The URN RID of the owning rank system (denormalized; equals the type's system).

typeId.description: The URN RID of the owning rank type.

RankCategory.description: A branch within a rank system (e.g. army, navy; or academic, administrative), ordered.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier; unique among active categories within the system.

id.description: The category's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

name.description: locale->text display name.

sortOrder.description: Seniority ordinal among active categories of the system.

systemId.description: The URN RID of the owning rank system.

types.description: The category's types in seniority order. Populated by getRankScheme; empty on create/update of the category.

RankGrade.description:
A standardized cross-system comparability node (NATO STANAG 2116): the seeded reference catalog
two ranks compare through. Equivalence = same code; seniority = tier then ordinal.

code.description: STANAG 2116 grade code (e.g. OF-5, OR-9, OF(D)).

name.description: Generic, nation-neutral grade label (not translatable; grades are reference data, not i18n entities).

tier.description: One of officer | warrant | enlisted (enlisted < warrant < officer for cross-tier seniority).

RankScheme.description: The whole scheme, systems -> categories -> types -> ranks, each level in seniority order.

RankSystem.description:
The top level of the scheme (D-RankSystems): a national/organizational rank ladder. One scheme
may hold several at once (a coalition directory); a single-nation deployment has one.

categories.description: The system's categories in seniority order. Populated by getRankScheme; empty on create/update of the system.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier (e.g. us-armed-forces); unique among active systems.

country.description: Country RID of the national origin (resolve via GET /geo/countries); absent for a supranational system (NATO/UN).

id.description: The system's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

name.description: locale->text display name.

RankType.description:
A band within a category (e.g. officers, warrant, enlisted), ordered. Types form a TREE: a
type may nest under another type of the same category (parentTypeId), and ranks attach to
LEAF types only.

categoryId.description: The URN RID of the owning rank category (the root category; carried on every type in the tree).

children.description: Child types in seniority order. Populated by getRankScheme; empty for a leaf type and on create/update.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier; unique among active siblings (same category + parent).

id.description: The type's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

name.description: locale->text display name.

parentTypeId.description: The URN RID of the parent type; absent for a root type of the category.

ranks.description: The type's ranks in seniority order (leaf types only). Populated by getRankScheme; empty on create/update of the type.

sortOrder.description: Seniority ordinal among active siblings (within the parent type, or the category for a root type).

systemId.description: The URN RID of the owning rank system (denormalized; equals the category's system).

RecordBranchRequest.description: Record that the given branch company is a branch of this company (the parent).

RecordFoundingRequest.description: Record a founder of this company (person or company holder).

RecordShareholdingRequest.description: Record a stake held in this company (person or company holder).

RecordSuccessionRequest.description: Record that this company (the predecessor) is succeeded by the given successor.

RegisterConnectorRequest.description:
A connector's idempotent self-description. Carries NO principalId: the core binds the row to
the calling principal, so a connector cannot register as another. Re-registering updates the
row and REPLACES the declared source set (sources absent from the payload are retired), which
makes boot-time registration converge without an operator reconciling drift by hand.

issuer.description: The IdP `iss` the machine's tokens carry.

subject.description:
The IdP `sub` the machine's tokens carry. For Keycloak this is the service-account user
id; a rejected unknown token logs its issuer/subject so it can be copied from there.

RegisterVehicleRequest.description:
Register the vehicle to a new owner (person or company). Any currently-active registration for
the vehicle is closed first (registration is the ownership history), so this also performs a
transfer. subdivisionId (the plate region) must be a geo_places region when supplied.

Registration.description:
The ownership+plate record (link__registered_to). The owner is a person OR a company
(polymorphic). country/subdivision carry the registering country + optional plate region. A
re-registration is a new row (the prior closed), so registration IS the ownership history.

ownerLabel.description: Best-effort display label (company legal name for company owners; empty for persons).

subdivisionId.description: The plate region — a geo_places RID (placetype=region).

RegistrationScheme.description: A registration-identifier scheme (LEI/DUNS/EDRPOU/VAT/EIN); isGlobal marks the worldwide spine.

RegulatorySanction.description:
A structured regulatory/enforcement action against a person (D-Watchlists, M34) — an Object.
Durable reference data (operator-curated or hermenea-imported), distinct from the volatile
live-lookup above. Idempotent import keys on (person, externalId). pii:sensitive.

actionType.description: One of fine | ban | license_revocation | warning | settlement | debarment | other.

currency.description: ISO-4217 code; required when amount is present.

externalId.description: The id within the source system (the import idempotency key).

status.description: One of active | appealed | overturned | expired | settled.

RelationType.description: An instance-admin catalog entry for an open-ended person↔person relation label (D-PersonRelationships). Stable code + translatable name + category.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier (D-Code); immutable by convention.

name.description: The translatable label as a locale -> text map (all enabled locales; D-i18n).

ReparentTaxonRequest.description: Move a taxon under a new parent, recomputing the closure. Cycle-guarded.

parentId.description: The new parent taxon; null makes the taxon a root religion.

ReparentUnitRequest.description: Move a unit under a new parent (same institution), recomputing the closure. Cycle-guarded.

parentId.description: The new parent unit; null makes the unit top-level.

ReportSyncRunRequest.description:
Report a run — opening it (`state: running`) and closing it (`succeeded`/`failed`) are the
same call. IDEMPOTENT on (source, externalRunId): a connector retrying its report updates the
run rather than duplicating it, which matters because connectors retry with backoff.

sourceCode.description: The source's code within the CALLING connector — not a RID, so a connector needs no prior read.

ResearchCentre.description: A research centre / institute / lab of an institution.

ResearchGroup.description: A research cluster under a centre and/or unit of an institution.

ResearchMembership.description: A person is a member of a research group.

Residence.description: A person's effective-dated residence in a country/region (D-Geo). Locator data (pii:contact).

validTo.description: ISO-8601 date the residence ended; null = current.

ResolveRequest.description:
Resolve a batch of natural keys to RIDs within one catalog, in a single round trip — the
connector's real need (mapping many rows), not one code at a time. `catalog` is one of
`country` (ISO-3166-1 alpha-2), `languoid` (glottocode), `writing-system` (ISO-15924). The
legal-basis catalog is code-keyed and has no RID, so it is a catalog READ, not a resolve target.

ResolveResponse.description:
`resolved` maps each FOUND code to its RID; `unresolved` lists the codes with no match, so a
connector can act on both without a second call.

RevokeOrderRequest.description: Revoke an issued order. The optional revoking order's RID is recorded as revoked_by_order_id.

Role.description: A named set of permission codes (Object Role). Base roles are seeded and immutable.

code.description: Stable, locale-agnostic identifier; immutable by convention.

description.description: The role description as a locale -> text map; empty when unset.

id.description: The role's URN RID (carried as a plain string).

isBase.description: True for seeded base roles (immutable by instance admins).

name.description: The role name as a locale -> text map (default-locale fallback + i18n translations).

permissions.description: The role's permission codes (the closed catalog; code-defined).

RolePage.description: A page of roles plus the opaque token for the next page (empty when exhausted).

Scholarship.description: A financial award scheme (institution or external).

ScholarshipAward.description: A person was awarded a scholarship.

SearchHit.description: One matched object, type-erased down to what every object shares.

label.description: Primary display line (person display name, catalog name, organization name, …).

objectType.description: The ontology registry token for the hit's type (e.g. person, languoid, company).

rid.description: The object's RID (canonical UUID text; self-describes service/kind/type).

ServicePrincipal.description:
A MACHINE subject (M51 / D-ServiceIdentities) — a facade with standing of its own, or a
connector. It authenticates through the same external IdP and the same middleware as a
person, using the OAuth2 client-credentials grant, and is keyed by the same
(issuer, subject) pair as an ExternalIdentity: a given pair is a person identity XOR a
principal, never both.

A principal holds NO role assignment and NO unit reach; its authority is the flat
per-principal grants owned by AuthorizationService. Registering one creates no credential —
the IdP owns the client secret (L-AuthzOnly holds).

TaxonStats.description:
Facet distributions over the SAME set `listTaxa` returns under the same filters (M58 /
D-ObjectFacets): `totalCount` is what exhaustively paging that endpoint would yield, not an
estimate and not a page count.

TWO of the four facets do NOT partition the result set, and this is a property of a
taxonomy rather than an inaccuracy:

- `subtree` counts each taxon under EVERY ancestor it has, because that is what makes the
  chart drillable — a bucket's count is its whole subtree size and clicking it returns
  exactly those rows, then re-grouping within them yields that subtree's own internal
  nodes, recursively, all the way down.
- `classification` counts EFFECTIVE theism tags, resolved to the nearest declaring ancestor
  (what `getEffectiveClassifications` returns), and a taxon may carry several.

So for those two, the buckets' counts SUM TO MORE than `totalCount`. What holds for every
facet without exception is the property the vocabulary actually rests on: a bucket's count
equals the number of rows `listTaxa` returns under that bucket's own filter.

One round-trip serves the whole dashboard.

get.description:
Facet distributions over the fleet — the dashboard half of the facet vocabulary (M58 /
D-ObjectFacets). Takes exactly the filter args `listVehicles` takes (minus paging) plus an
optional `facets` CSV, so a dashboard and a list are two renderings of ONE request state
and a chart segment is a link to the same URL with one more filter applied.

`totalCount` equals the number of rows exhaustively paging `listVehicles` with these same
filters would return. One round-trip serves the whole dashboard.

ONE aggregate arm, with no subject and no scoped twin — for the same reason
`externalOrgStats` has one, and NOT the audit ledger's reason. `vehicle_vehicles` carries no
row-level security, no unit column and no reach predicate: `vehicle.read` held anywhere is
the whole visibility decision, so there is nothing for a second arm to narrow.

The path is `/stats/vehicles` rather than `/vehicles/stats` because the server's router
rejects a literal path segment that is a sibling of `{vehicleId}`.
